contract.get_access_token: get_access_token(data_dir: Path) -> str | None. None iff neither secrets/oura_oauth.json nor data_dir/oura_oauth.json exists. Use shared oauth_token_source selection. Lock data_dir/.oura_oauth.lock before reading/exchanging. Expiry within 60 seconds refreshes via form POST using tenant client files. Require access_token, NEW refresh_token, positive finite expires_in. Persist to data_dir/oura_oauth.json as 0600 via same-directory temp, fsync, atomic replace and directory fsync BEFORE returning access. Broken OAuth, exchange or write errors raise; never return a PAT. Seed is never written. Missing token_url defaults to documented cloud endpoint; a saved URL must be allowlisted before any exchange.
contract.authorize_oura: authorize_oura(data_dir: Path, portal: str = "cloud") -> None. Only cloud is supported, also for applications created in the new developer portal; reject other portal values before reading client files. Print cloud authorize URL with exactly daily workout spo2 stress, exact http://localhost:9876/callback/, unpredictable state and S256 PKCE. Read hidden pasted full redirect; validate exact origin/path, one matching state, no fragment/error, exactly one nonempty code before exchange. POST authorization_code to https://api.ouraring.com/oauth/token with matching redirect/verifier. Lock and save initial grant to writable data as above. Print no secrets/tokens/code. Script entry resolves HEALTH_DATA_DIR/data, defaults ~/health/data; errors exit 1; native argparse rejects --portal developer. Persist token_url for refresh; accept only the hardcoded cloud HTTPS token endpoint before any client read or exchange.
contract.limits: Cloud route for old/new portal apps. Owner observed first authorization and import working 2026-10-02; moi developer endpoint returned HTTP400 and is disabled. Fresh stress consent and subsequent resilience import remain owner follow-up after deploy, as does first real refresh. Existing grants do not gain scopes automatically and legacy moi tokens must be reauthorized. No automatic endpoint fallback/retry after ambiguous rotation; fsync cannot undo server rotation after lost response/disk failure. Presence on onboarding is not proof of valid credentials. Host filesystem must support flock/atomic rename.
